Definition: a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token
BiblicalUsage: 1) something lifted up, standard, signal, signal pole, ensign, banner, sign, sail; 1a) standard (as rallying point), signal; 1b) standard (pole); 1c) ensign, signal
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
